# ClickHouse Native Hello correction

`15-clickhouse-valid.pcapng` is a derived **synthetic** positive fixture. The
original PR #5174 capture remains unchanged at `../captures/15-clickhouse.pcapng`
and remains in the 30-capture SHA-pinned corpus.

The original generator's `buildClickHouse` wrote the server Hello body without
its packet-type varint. A ClickHouse Native server packet begins with its packet
type; Hello is type 0. The original generator's own verifier omitted this field
as well, so it did not expose the malformed capture. A strict recognizer must
not invent a valid server Hello or Pong from those bytes. The original capture
therefore serves as a negative integration fixture.

This corrected capture was generated by copying the six original Go generator
source files to a temporary directory and inserting exactly this line in
`buildClickHouse`, immediately after `var server []byte`:

```go
server = append(server, chVarint(0)...) // Native Server Hello packet type
```

Then a temporary Go test wrote `pcapOf(buildClickHouse)` to this file. The TCP
payload gains the single 0x00 byte; the pcapng packet is re-encoded with updated
IP/TCP lengths/checksums and block padding. All other application fields and
the conversation are generated by the original code.

- Original SHA-256: `b6a8a531159e55934ec0a0e2e9730debb5b6b9f2cea98c1a8fbe5fa112bde409`
- Corrected SHA-256: `663f6e2803d2342d2420ba8076cac2371613e2cd6089d0944329cbcb7647cbf5`
- Expected strict native events: client Hello, server Hello, client Ping, server Pong.
- Specification: [ClickHouse server native protocol](https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-docs/blob/main/docs/native-protocol/server.md) and [ClickHouse C++ client](https://github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-cpp/blob/master/clickhouse/client.cpp).
